messages.author: d4cef92e68d3dd8d
messages.subject: AMOVA among clades
parts:
Hi,

We identified three clades for one species across Europe. I'm trying to test genetic variation among these groups. These clades are widespread in several countries with sympatric distribution. Can I use AMOVA test for this analysis? Should this analysis be used only for geographically distinct populations?

I'm trying to perform the AMOVA in the Arlequin software.

Thanks a lot

messages.author: d4586792679cf1d0
messages.subject: Re: [poppr] AMOVA among clades
parts:
You can test for population differentiation using different approaches including AMOVA, Gst, and others. AMOVA can be done within R or you can export data and conduct it in Arlequin.

Best,
Nik
